display.purpose: Hero and major page-level statements only.

compact-display.purpose: Responsive hero display below the compact breakpoint.

body.purpose: Interface language and readable supporting copy.

lead.purpose: Fluid supporting copy beneath the hero statement.

brand.purpose: The Klex wordmark beside the emblem.

footer.purpose: Compact footer copyright and credit links.

shadows.name: status-halo
shadows.purpose: A restrained halo for a small active status signal; not a surface elevation.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Quiet feedback for text links and low-complexity states.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Near-instant transitions when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clear default action, compact and friendly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 2rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-primary-solid); color: var(--color-solid-foreground); font: 600 0.875rem/1 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary-solid) 90%, var(--color-foreground)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-solid); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A restrained secondary action with an honest border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 2rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-foreground); font: 600 0.875rem/1 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-surface-1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-solid); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis utility action that appears through interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 2rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 600 0.875rem/1 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-surface-1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-solid); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact, transparent field using the shared border and focus language.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-border), var(--color-foreground) 18%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-primary-solid); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary-solid) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: A flat content container separated by a quiet ring rather than a shadow.
components.html:
One durable coworker

Identity and context travel with Klex.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-foreground); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-foreground) 10%, transparent); font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--color-surface-1); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-solid); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; font-variation-settings: "WONK" 0, "opsz" 0; font-optical-sizing: none; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Minimal Navigation
components.description: A typography-led navigation pattern with direct link feedback.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--color-muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 0.25rem; transition: color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-foreground); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: var(--color-foreground); outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-solid); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 0.125rem; }

narrative.overview:
Klex should feel intelligent without feeling difficult. Fraunces gives the brand a thoughtful, human voice; Geist and the stagewise UI foundation keep every interaction direct, legible, and familiar. The result is warm, precise, approachable, intelligent, and human.

The system is honest and open rather than mysterious or theatrical. It should communicate that a capable autonomous coworker is present while hiding unnecessary machinery. Simple wins: hierarchy comes from type, spacing, a restrained warm-neutral palette, and one clear signal accent rather than decorative effects.
keyCharacteristics: Flat and honest, with functional depth only where needed.
Consistent with the shadcn-based `@stagewise/ui` component system.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the primary accent to communicate action, focus, or status. Do not spread it across large decorative surfaces.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Prefer `@stagewise/ui` semantic variables such as `--color-background`, `--color-foreground`, and `--color-primary-solid`; do not hard-code parallel Klex values.

rules.name: The Intelligent Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for meaning and hierarchy, not controls or dense operational copy.

rules.name: The Fixed Character Rule
rules.body: Set Fraunces with the wonk axis at zero and explicitly request the optical-size axis at zero while disabling automatic optical sizing. Browsers may clamp optical size to the font's published minimum.

rules.name: The One Clear Thought Rule
rules.body: Each major viewport should have one dominant message and enough open space for it to read immediately.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and controls remain visually grounded at rest. Interaction may change tone, border, or position by a single pixel, but should not turn the interface into floating glass.

dos: Do use Fraunces to make major statements feel intelligent and human.
Do use Geist Variable and shared shadcn patterns to keep interaction simple.
Do consume semantic tokens and components from `@stagewise/ui`.
Do create hierarchy with whitespace, type, quiet borders, and restrained tonal changes.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and motion compatible with reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't duplicate the shared palette with local hard-coded approximations.
Don't use saturated accent color as general decoration.
Don't add ornamental gradients, glass effects, or persistent shadows to make simple surfaces feel impressive.
Don't use Fraunces for controls, dense metadata, or long operational copy.
Don't expose technical complexity when a familiar, obvious interaction will do.
